evals.prompt: Set up structured JSON logging with OpenTelemetry trace context propagation for a Python FastAPI service.
evals.expected_output: A logging configuration module emitting structured JSON log lines with trace_id, span_id, timestamp, and severity levels.
assertions: Emits logs strictly in structured JSON format instead of plaintext print statements
Includes trace_id and span_id correlation fields extracted from active OpenTelemetry context
Captures contextual metadata (service name, timestamp, environment, severity)

evals.prompt: Implement a resilient HTTP client adapter with hard timeouts, exponential backoff retries, and an OpenTelemetry span.
evals.expected_output: An HTTP client class wrapping requests or httpx with explicit timeout, tenacity retry with exponential backoff, and otel tracing spans.
assertions: Enforces hard timeout on every outgoing HTTP request
Implements retry with exponential backoff and maximum retry bound
Creates OpenTelemetry span around the external call capturing HTTP status and error tags
Fails closed without unhandled exceptions crashing the service
